messages:
emily: Quick follow-up from the postmortem  we need to close communications action items. Key asks: final status page sentence, 72h customer summary, and a clear RCA-sharing policy.

raj: I can draft the statuspage blurb. Proposal: "We experienced elevated latency on Text Gen API from 02:203:05 UTC due to cache eviction triggered during a model rollout. Rollback applied; mitigation in progress. No customer data exposed."

maria: Good. Add a short mitigation note: "Rollback + temporary throttling applied to stabilize requests." Also want legal to confirm wording on "No customer data exposed."

legal: Confirmed  we have no evidence of data exposure; you can include that sentence. Legal recommends redacting orchestration commands and internal hostnames from public text.

sec-bot: Security scan: no exfiltration detected. Signed off.

prodops: Once statuspage text is final, we can push immediately. Please post final sentence in #statuspage-drafts.

emily: Action items: 1) Raj: finalize statuspage sentence and post (due 2325000020). 2) Maria: coordinate 72h customer summary draft, include TL;DR, timeline, impact metrics, top-4 FAQs (due 2325000040). 3) Eng-runtime (owner): create guardrail ticket to prevent KV eviction during rollouts (due 2325000060). 4) Legal: post redaction checklist (due 2325000030).

eng-runtime: Creating ticket RUNTIME-812, set P1 for rollout guardrails.

raj: Posted final statuspage blurb to #statuspage-drafts and pinged ProdOps.

maria: I'll draft the 72h note and include FAQ items: "Was my data affected?", "What caused this?", "How was it fixed?", "What prevents recurrence?"

legal: Redaction checklist posted: remove internal hostnames/IPs, low-level orchestration steps, and customer identifiers.

emily: Great. We'll publish the public summary after legal/sec sign-off and offer expanded RCAs to affected enterprise customers under NDA. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

maria: Marking this thread closed; will reopen if blockers appear. :wave:
